drivingQuestion: Is the mishna's permission to add to the ketubah redundant?
outcomeNote: The clause is needed to exclude a supposed rabbinic cap.

segments.he: גְּמָ׳ פְּשִׁיטָא? מַהוּ דְּתֵימָא: קִיצּוּתָא עֲבַדוּ רַבָּנַן שֶׁלֹּא לְבַיֵּישׁ אֶת מִי שֶׁאֵין לוֹ, קָא מַשְׁמַע לַן.
segments.en: «GEMARA:» The mishna states that if he wishes to add to the obligation in the marriage contract, he may do so. The Gemara asks: «Isn’t» it «obvious» that if he wishes to add he may do so? The Gemara explains: «Lest you say» that «the Sages instituted a fixed» ceiling on the amount one may designate in the marriage contract, in order «not to embarrass one who does not have» sufficient funds, the mishna therefore «teaches us» that the Sages were not specific about this. If he wishes to add to the amount, he may do so.
